name: fold_kit
scene: twin bits_kit_fold (T067 steps 1-5 of lerobot/docs/annotation_notes/rebot_tasks.md). No hand-written sim scorer yet: the ladder below is a proposal to align with the scorer the twin agent adds.
script: grasp the outer edge of the flap with the bits
fold the flap with the bits over the middle of the kit
grasp the outer edge of the flap with the white card
fold the flap with the white card over the folded flap

subtasks.text: reach toward the edge of the bits flap
subtasks.criterion: gripper open and moving toward the outer edge of the flap that holds the bits; kit fully open

subtasks.text: pinch the edge of the bits flap
subtasks.criterion: fingers closed on the fabric edge of the bits flap; flap still flat on the table

subtasks.text: swing the bits flap over the middle
subtasks.criterion: bits flap held and lifting or rotating toward the middle panel of the kit

subtasks.text: release the bits flap on the middle
subtasks.criterion: bits flap lying on the middle panel; fingers opening or just opened

subtasks.text: reach toward the edge of the card flap
subtasks.criterion: gripper open and moving toward the outer edge of the flap with the white card; bits flap already folded

subtasks.text: pinch the edge of the card flap
subtasks.criterion: fingers closed on the fabric edge of the card flap; flap still flat

subtasks.text: swing the card flap over the folded flap
subtasks.criterion: card flap held and rotating over the already folded bits flap
card flap lying on top of the folded bits flap; fingers opening or just opened
closed or open gripper pushing down on the folded kit
gripper empty, kit folded, arm moving away or back to its home pose
arm not moving for the whole strip, or doing something none of the entries above describes (flap unfolds again, gripper empty away from the kit)

stages.name: none
stages.criterion: kit fully open, nothing below holds

stages.name: reach_bits_flap
stages.criterion: finger midpoint within a few cm of the bits flap edge

stages.name: bits_flap_pinched
stages.criterion: both fingers on the bits flap edge

stages.name: bits_flap_over_middle
stages.criterion: bits flap folded more than halfway toward the middle panel

stages.name: bits_flap_folded
stages.criterion: bits flap resting on the middle panel, gripper off it

stages.name: card_flap_pinched
stages.criterion: both fingers on the card flap edge

stages.name: card_flap_over
stages.criterion: card flap folded more than halfway over the bits flap

stages.name: kit_folded
stages.criterion: card flap resting on the folded bits flap, gripper off it

stages.name: pressed_flat
stages.criterion: kit folded and pressed; gripper lifted off it
